title: Circuits: Current, Resistance and Potential Difference

flashcard_questions.q: The flow of electrical charge around a circuit, measured in amperes (A) using an ammeter.
The unit of electric current, symbol A.
An instrument used to measure electric current, connected in series with the component being tested.

flashcard_questions.a: The energy transferred per unit of charge passed, measured in volts (V) using a voltmeter. Also called voltage.
The unit of potential difference, symbol V.
